description: List a podcast's entire back-catalog (every episode, newest first). Pass a podcast_id from a search_podcasts result. Returns each episode's id, title, and date — fetch any with get_transcript. Use this to transcribe a whole show. Does not consume credits itself; transcribing the returned episodes costs 1 credit each (repeat fetches are free), so make sure the key has enough credits before looping.

podcast_id.description: Show id (the podcast_id field from a search_podcasts result).

name: list_episodes

count.description: Episodes listed; fetching all of them costs up to this many credits.

id.description: Episode id; pass it to get_transcript.

podcast_id.description: Show id; pass it to list_episodes or follow_podcast.

title: List a show's episodes
